title: sida peduncularis
intro: Sida peduncularis, commonly known as the "pigeonwings," is a perennial plant species belonging to the Malvaceae family. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include its health benefits in treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues due to its immune-boosting and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Sida peduncularis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight bacterial and fungal infections, and act as an antioxidant. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
